name: usage-bar
description: A line above the message box with your context fill and your session (5h) and weekly usage limits, plus an optional stats line for the last run

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Color of the wave, the highlights and the separators: a hex code (#e8876a), a name (orange, green, blue, purple, pink, teal, lavender, peach), or random for a new color at each message

showStats.title: Stats line
showStats.description: Show the last run's duration, tools, tokens and cost, and the conversation's total cost, above the bar
